name: ai-markdown
description: Markdown rendering for AI applications: incremental streaming, LaTeX math, GFM, and CJK typography. Shared engine and core, React and Mantine integrations; Vue in development.

paragraphs: React and Vue Markdown rendering for AI responses: GFM, KaTeX math, CJK-aware parsing, incremental streaming, and shared references across logical document sections. Use either framework adapter with your own UI, or the React Mantine integration for highlighted code, JSON presentation, and Mermaid diagrams.
features: Accumulated streaming input. Pass the complete current Markdown string to one component. The engine reuses a verified prefix when the input is an append and the grammar permits it; otherwise it uses a full parse.

Reusable rendered blocks. The React adapter retains React elements for unchanged plans. Custom components can still update through state and context, so streaming status and application callbacks remain live.

Math and mixed-language text. Built-in normalization handles common model-produced math delimiters and currency text. The pipeline includes CJK-aware delimiter parsing and optional pangu spacing; typography and source…
